proposals.summary: Counts from zero through five and returns five without accessing actor records.

evidence.detail: Lines 877-881 increment i until it exceeds four and return i.

proposals.summary: Sets the actor combat-team byte to 2, enabling its participation as an enemy target.

evidence.detail: Writes 2 to actor byte 0x1DC.
Player attack contacts reject actors whose 0x1DC equals the player team or is zero.
Ability target enumeration skips enemies whose byte 0x1DC is zero.

proposals.summary: Clears the actor combat-team byte, excluding it from attacks that require a nonzero target team.

evidence.detail: Clears actor byte 0x1DC.
Player attack contacts reject actors with zero combat-team byte.
Ability targeting skips zero-team enemies.

proposals.summary: Finds the first active actor with the nonzero record key and stores the low byte of value as its combat team.

evidence.detail: Rejects key zero.
Searches five actor records at stride 0x2E0.
Requires the active-mask bit and record key at offset 2 to match.
Stores value into combat-team byte 0x1DC.
Attack processing rejects same-team and zero-team targets.

proposals.summary: Finds the active actor matching a nonzero record key and sets its task-exit flag.

evidence.detail: Matches active actor records by halfword key at offset 2.
Sets bit 0 of actor flags at offset 0x7A.
Enemy update task runs only while this bit remains clear.
Task teardown clears the actor active-slot bit.

proposals.summary: Sets overlay animation index 0x88 on the first active actor matching the supplied record key.

evidence.detail: Searches active actor entries for matching halfword record key.
Stores the requested halfword at offset 0x88.
Enemy update advances the overlay animation indexed by f88 and clears it at completion.
Draws that overlay above the actor position.

proposals.summary: Sets scene field 0x5A to one and requests AI action reselection for each active actor carrying flag 0x7A bit 2.

evidence.detail: Sets scene halfword 0x5A to one; the broader scene meaning is not inferred.
Filters five actor slots by active mask.
For actors with flags 0x7A bit 2, overwrites AI flags 0x201 with one.
AI flags bit 0 enters the action-selection branch.
Action selection clears the request bit and changes the action when needed.

open_questions: What additional behavior does scene halfword 0x5A control?

proposals.summary: Marks an actor with flag 0x7A bit 2, clears its AI flags and resets its selected action to 0xFF.

evidence.detail: Selects actor slot using the 0x2E0 record stride.
Sets actor flags bit 2.
Clears AI flags 0x201.
Sets selected action 0x1FD to the no-action sentinel 0xFF.
AI action selection clears its request and assigns a new action through the same fields.

open_questions: The precise persistent policy associated with actor flags 0x7A bit 2 remains unnamed.

proposals.summary: Configures enemy knockback duration, speed, magnitude and direction from a hit packet; zero magnitude clears duration, speed and direction.

evidence.detail: Reads hit-packet impulse byte 2.
Sets duration to impulse divided by four; lines 892-899 ensure minimum one tick and select speed 0x100 or 0x400.
Copies signed hit direction; lines 906-908 clear duration, speed and direction for zero impulse.
Enemy update consumes these fields in a movement step and decrements the duration.

proposals.summary: Configures player knockback duration, speed, magnitude and direction from a hit packet; zero magnitude clears duration, speed and magnitude.

evidence.detail: Reads hit impulse byte 2.
Stores knockback duration at player offset 0xCE.
Stores signed direction; zero path at 943-945 clears duration, speed and magnitude but leaves direction unchanged.
Player update moves using speed 0xD2 and direction 0xD0, then decrements duration 0xCE.

proposals.summary: Queues enemy damage and outward knockback from a supplied position, marks local-player hit credit and broadcasts the hit packet.

evidence.detail: Sets enemy state to damage reaction 10.
Computes direction from supplied position toward the enemy.
Accumulates pending damage at 0x4A and records display damage at 0x4C.
Configures enemy knockback from the packet.
Sets the local-player bit in the enemy hit-credit mask.
Calls the hit-packet link queue producer sub_080660EC.

proposals.summary: Once per attack sequence, queues a percentage of maximum player health as self-damage when the combat team and positive rate permit it.

evidence.detail: Requires attack sequence 0xDC to differ from previously charged sequence 0x10C and team byte 0x68 to be nonzero.
Rejects zero rates and rates whose high bit is set.
Computes max health at offset 0x62 times rate byte 0x69 divided by 100, with minimum one.
Adds the amount to pending health deduction 0x8A; records the charged sequence and clears 0xE0.
Called in the player attack-contact path after attack-specific frame gates.
Player damage application subtracts pending halfword 0x8A from current health 0xC4 and then clears it.
Derived stat buffer starts at player offset 0x58; the rate byte 0x69 is its offset 0x11, initialized to zero in stat recalculation at line 865.

open_questions: Which equipment or stat effect supplies the health-cost rate byte 0x69?

proposals.summary: For class 0 or 3, scales a halfword value as (signed value + 2L)*(L+10)/10 using effective skill index 4 or 3 respectively; other classes retain the input.

evidence.detail: Reads normalized character class.
Class 0 reads effective indexed skill 4 twice before scaling.
Class 3 reads skill 3 twice; both branches return the low halfword of the formula.
Equipment detail formatting uses the scaled value minus item field 0x9B as a displayed bonus.
Equipment stat recalculation independently inlines the identical class-sensitive 4/3 skill formula into the equipment defense contribution.

open_questions: Exact player-facing skill label is not established; the name deliberately describes the higher-indexed member of this helper pair.

proposals.summary: Returns eight times effective skill index 3 for class 0 or index 2 for class 3, and otherwise returns the low halfword of the fallback argument.
